title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD NAMES THE MINIMAP
why: The card was stamped v25.31 and the stamp may not trail the build by more than 0.15. The card was stamped v25.31 and every ship stops when it falls 0.16 behind; about 17 finished builds are still queued. Its new line names the builds since: the minimap and its markers (his order add minimap), CAREER waves (his mode design), the plate and injector foley (his sound orders) and the crawler latch (his order).
now: The what is new card names the minimap.

edits.anchor: 'THIS IS AN ALPHA. Things will break. When something does, the game writes it into your run report and tells you so; that report is how it gets fixed.',
